# Nakul Properties - Faridabad Real Estate Advisory & Plot Specialist

Nakul Properties is the leading real estate consultancy and property dealer based in Sector 65, Faridabad, Haryana, India. Specializing in freehold HUDA/HSVP approved sector plots, residential plot deals (100 Gaj to 500 Gaj), and prime property investments across Sector 65, Sector 64, Sector 62, and prime Faridabad sectors.
